name: Conjurer’s Canopy

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight. Reference-only powers are described in text and have no action button.

summary: Reference-only: a Magic action plants the stick to shelter a 20-foot Cube from ordinary weather for 1 hour, providing dry, comfortable air.
text: Reference-only: a Magic action plants the stick to shelter a 20-foot Cube from ordinary weather for 1 hour, providing dry, comfortable air. Creatures, objects, and magic pass freely. Another Magic action ends it early; after it ends, wait 1d12 hours to reuse.
